name: power word kill
lore:
# Power Word Kill

To utter this syllable is to claim the prerogative of gods. Legend attributes its discovery to **Malakor the Silent**, an archmage who spent centuries listening to the entropy of the Void until he heard the single, discordant note that terminates existence. He did not invent the spell; he merely translated the universe’s final punctuation.

When shaping the Weave for this casting, one does not feel the warmth of fire or the hum of lightning. Instead, the air turns brittle, and the mage feels a terrifying, absolute stillness—as if the heart of the world has skipped a beat. It is the sensation of a single thread being snipped from a grand tapestry.

Visually, the spell lacks the vulgarity of explosions. There is no projectile, no shimmering aura. Upon the word’s utterance, reality ripples with a microscopic, colorless tremor. The target does not succumb to wound or disease; they simply *cease*. The light in their eyes vanishes instantly, replaced by the hollow vacancy of a vessel whose pilot has been deleted by the very laws of reality. 

*Caution: To speak it is to invite the void into one's own throat.*
